definitions.explanation: A small amount of an ingredient added to enhance flavor without being detectably present. The ingredient improves the dish subtly but isn't meant to be identified.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隠|かく}し{味|あじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{蜂蜜|はちみつ}→蜂蜜：14045_hachimitsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The secret ingredient in this curry is honey.

examples.japanese: {隠|かく}し{味|あじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
examples.english: Add a little miso as a secret ingredient.

examples.japanese: {隠|かく}し{味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}いて→効く：01932_kiku⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{味|あじ}わい→味わい：11899_ajiwai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The secret ingredient works well, giving it a deep flavor.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {隠|かく}し{味|あじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧ (to add a secret ingredient)
- {隠|かく}し{味|あじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use ~ as a secret ingredient)
- {隠|かく}し{味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧ (the secret ingredient works/takes effect)

COMMON {隠|かく}し{味|あじ} INGREDIENTS:
- ⟦{蜂蜜|はちみつ}→蜂蜜：14045_hachimitsu⟧ (honey) - in curry, dressings
- ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧ (miso) - in soups, stews
- ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧ (soy sauce) - in Western dishes
- ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧ (vinegar) - to brighten flavors
- ⟦{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}→牛乳：00777_gyuunyuu⟧ (milk) - in tomato-based dishes
- インスタント⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧ (instant coffee) - in chocolate dishes

USAGE:
The key concept is that the ingredient enhances flavor without being obviously detectable. If you can clearly taste it, it's no longer a {隠|かく}し{味|あじ}.

WRITING:
- ⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧ (to hide) + ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧ (flavor) = hidden flavor

cross_references.note: to hide; the verb the compound is built on
